description: Focused wave packet RS1 (spilling) of Rapp & Melville (1990), S = 0.278, in the set-up of Derakhti & Kirby (2016): depth 0.6 m, f_c = 0.88 Hz, df/f_c = 0.73, 32 components of constant amplitude, linear focus x = 8.5 m, t = 20.5 s (B 92 51, relaxation zone 2 m, beach 6 m, flume 30 m, dx 0.02 m, 16 layers), FNPF with A 350 4. Energy loss = 1 - <int eta^2 dt> over x = 10.5-12.5 m / over x = 4.5-6.5 m.
xfail: The spilling packet RS1 is not detected as breaking: B = u_s/C of the crest tracking (A 350 4) peaks at 0.80-0.83 < A 359 0.85 at dx 0.02 m, so the loss (3.6 %) is the scheme's (LES 14 %). Breaking onset of spilling deep-water crests at this resolution; see NHFLOW Breaking v5 validation 09.
